row.body: The lease key is issued before the building inspection; a test note says the rear water line is not ready for tenant use.
row.title: Lease before inspection

cites.quote: Premises with Apartments for Lease (listing no. 891)

sidecar.gloss: A tenant key is issued while a water line remains unapproved.
sidecar.rival_reading: An emergency inspection could delay move-in after a building problem; the note does not identify the source.

row.body: field dust covers one side of the blue pen and animal-feed sack; torn warning tape covers the other. the bundle was opened from both ends.
row.title: two traces on the blue pen

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
